About the job

About the Company

Give Grants enables large Indian corporations and foundations to deliver maximum social impact. Using a combination of consulting services, operations support and technology platforms, we work with 100+ companies and grantmakers.


About the Role

We are looking for proactive and driven interns to join our NGO Engagement team. The role involves working closely with NGO partners across India to facilitate their participation in high-impact programs.


Responsibilities

  • NGO Outreach & Engagement: Reach out to NGO partners across India via call, email, and virtual meetings.
  • Present and pitch the Google for AI program to NGO leadership.
  • Build interest and convince partners to participate actively.
  • Track engagement and ensure onboarding completion.
